title: plans-migrator request
description: Input of the extension point workspace:plans-migrator: inspect the plans of a checkout, apply the migration into the workspace, or verify the plans of a folder. The request is a call between processes of one machine, not a portable document, so it names absolute folders.

folder.description: Absolute path of an existing folder on this machine.

manifestFile.description: One file of the source, by its path relative to plans/.

manifest.description: The answer of inspect, as it was read; apply recomputes it under the locks and compares the digest.

plans.description: Plan folders and legacy folders of the source.

items.description: One folder of plans/ or plans/archive/.

digest.description: Digest of the sorted (path, sha256) pairs.

top_level.description: Loose files of plans/ (they go to legacy-plans/_root).

inspect.description: Classify plans/ of a checkout and list its files with sizes and digests.

workspace_root.description: Root of the workspace (not read by inspect).

apply.description: Run the critical section of the migration for the manifest of a dry run.

workspace_root.description: Root of the workspace; staging lives inside it.

op_id.description: Id of the operation; names the staging folder.

mode.description: initial: the workspace holds no plans of the project; import: it may.

on_conflict.description: What to do with a plan whose copy in the workspace differs.

device_short.description: Short device name for the suffix of an imported copy.

lock_timeout_s.description: Seconds to wait for each PlanLock.

verify.description: Load the plans of a folder through the planner store and compare the errors of check with a baseline.

plans_root.description: Folder with the plan folders to verify.

compare_to.description: Folder with the baseline plans of the same names.

unbound.description: Check plans_root as plans without a checkout.

compare_to_unbound.description: Check the baseline as plans without a checkout.
